demo: LOGOS tick-to-trade: NASDAQ ITCH-lite -> price-ladder book -> microprice market-making -> pre-trade risk -> order, on the full LOGOS soft-core.
provenance: Per-message cycles are the on-chip run-cycle counter in cycle-accurate RTL sim (tb_hft.v) of the SAME full core the bitstream routes; the Show/order stream is bit-exact to the LOGOS VM and to the Python reference (hft_model.py). The UART round-trip is the dev loom, not the trade path — the HFT-relevant number is the on-chip cycle count. Absolute ns is that measured cycle count / clock, per tier.

chip.note: Deterministic silicon: identical input -> identical cycle count on EVERY run (zero jitter). The band is data-dependent work across message types, not jitter.

x86_baseline.impl: tight -O2 C, identical pipeline (hft_baseline.c), per-message rdtscp timing
x86_baseline.note: A GHz CPU wins median latency vs a 6.25 MHz FPGA — but leaks in the TAIL (OS/cache/branch jitter), which is where HFT money leaks and which worsens under load.
